mapper.select: SELECT id, external_userid, follow_userid, state, crm_lead_id, crm_contact_id, crm_event_id, raw_json, remark, add_way, tags, description, oper_userid, follow_create_time, remark_mobiles, create_time, update_time FROM crm_wecom_external_contact WHERE external_userid = #{externalUserid} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, external_userid, follow_userid, state, crm_lead_id, crm_contact_id, crm_event_id, raw_json, remark, add_way, tags, description, oper_userid, follow_create_time, remark_mobiles, create_time, update_time FROM crm_wecom_external_contact WHERE external_userid = #{externalUserid} AND follow_userid = #{followUserid}

SELECT id, external_userid, follow_userid, state, crm_lead_id, crm_contact_id, crm_event_id, raw_json, remark, add_way, tags, description, oper_userid, follow_create_time, remark_mobiles, create_time, update_time FROM crm_wecom_external_contact WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_external_contact ( external_userid, follow_userid, raw_json, crm_contact_id, remark, add_way, tags, description, oper_userid, follow_create_time, remark_mobiles, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{externalUserid}, #{followUserid}, #{rawJson}, #{crmContactId}, #{remark}, #{addWay}, #{tags}, #{description}, #{operUserid}, #{followCreateTime}, #{remarkMobiles}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (external_userid, follow_userid) DO UPDATE SET raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json, crm_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_contact_id, crm_wecom_external_contact.crm_contact_id), remark = EXCLUDED.remark, add_way = EXCLUDED.add_way, tags = EXCLUDED.tags, description = EXCLUDED.description, oper_userid = EXCLUDED.oper_userid, follow_create_time = EXCLUDED.follow_create_time, remark_mobiles = EXCLUDED.remark_mobiles, update_time = NOW()
